# API reference

<!-- Generated by `make generate` from internal/httpapi/openapi.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Single-user calorie log. Errors are RFC 9457 problems with a stable `code`.

All paths are under `/api/v1`. Every operation needs a session cookie unless it says *public*. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`, a `detail`, and a `request_id`. The full machine-readable contract is `internal/httpapi/openapi.json`; the client types are generated from it.

## auth

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/login` | Sign in with email and password | public | 200, default |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | End this session | public | 204, default |
| POST | `/auth/logout-all` | End every session for this user | session | 204, default |
| GET | `/auth/me` | The signed-in user | session | 200, default |

## backup

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/export` | Full JSON backup | session | 200, default |
| POST | `/import` | Restore a backup, replacing current data | session | 200, 422, 500 |

## days

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/days` | Per-day totals for a date range (at most 366 days) | session | 200, 422, 500 |
| GET | `/days/{date}` | Entries and totals for one local date | session | 200, 422, 500 |

## entries

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/entries/{id}` | One entry, including a tombstone | session | 200, 404, 422, 500 |
| PUT | `/entries/{id}` | Create or update an entry (idempotent by client ID) | session | 200, 409, 422, 500 |
| DELETE | `/entries/{id}` | Tombstone an entry (idempotent) | session | 204, 404, 422, 500 |

## foods

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/foods/barcode/{code}` | Resolve a barcode to a loggable food | session | 200, 404, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/foods/recent` | Distinct foods logged most recently | session | 200, default |
| GET | `/foods/search` | Search foods by name, brand or barcode | session | 200, default |
| PUT | `/foods/{id}` | Create a custom food or correct an existing one | session | 200, 409, 422, 500 |
| GET | `/foods/{id}/favorite` | Is this food a favorite? | session | 200, 404, 422, 500 |
| PUT | `/foods/{id}/favorite` | Mark a food as a favorite (idempotent) | session | 200, 404, 422, 500 |
| DELETE | `/foods/{id}/favorite` | Remove a favorite (idempotent) | session | 200, 404, 422, 500 |

## sync

| Method | Path | What it does | Auth | Responses |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/sync/meta` | Stream bounds and whether sync is enabled | session | 200, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/sync/pull` | Changes after a cursor, oldest first | session | 200, 409, 422, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/sync/push` | Apply a batch of client mutations | session | 200, 422, 500, 503 |
